names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Александр (Буравцев), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «… и Александра пресвитеров». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Василия и Александра пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: The second of the two the day’s seventh line names, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind him. The line says «пресвитеров» and the name page «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source’s own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Буравцев» over every `saint.json` returns nothing. The day page prints seven hymns and none is under either name.
